events.title: Pasko Fiesta All Over the City 2026
events.description: Davao City Tourism Operations Office invitation for city barangays and private establishments to join a Christmas display and activities competition. Registration is open through November 30, 2026; pre-judging is December 3, finalists are announced December 5, and final judging is December 6–12. This is a competition schedule, not a public event calendar.
events.notes: Dates and registration information are transcribed from the City announcement and have not received Requisito's independent review.

transitRoutes.title: Davao City Transport Roadmap
transitRoutes.description: The City Government's transportation planning page links a Transport Roadmap summary report and English/Bisaya brochure. This is a planning reference, not a current jeepney route list, live bus map, or schedule.
transitRoutes.notes: The City page links materials published in 2019. Do not use them as current service or route instructions without checking with the responsible transport office.

heritageSites.title: Museo Dabawenyo
heritageSites.description: A museum division of the City Mayor's Office established to preserve and exhibit materials related to Davao's history, culture, and arts. The City page lists museum tours and art-exhibition requests; contact the museum for current visitor arrangements.
heritageSites.notes: Visitor hours and location details are not repeated here because they can change; confirm them with the museum.

tourismPlaces.title: KAGIKAN: The Kadayawan Cultural Village
tourismPlaces.description: A Davao City Tourism Operations Office cultural-tourism initiative named by the City in its report on the 2026 ATOP Pearl Awards. The linked City story reports it as a finalist in a sustainable-tourism category; it does not provide current visitor hours or access arrangements.
tourismPlaces.notes: This listing is based on a dated City news article, not a current visitor guide. Contact the City Tourism Operations Office before planning a visit.

tourismPlaces.title: Museo Dabawenyo
tourismPlaces.description: City museum with exhibits and services relating to Davao history, culture, and arts. Ask the museum to confirm current opening arrangements and any visitor guidance.
tourismPlaces.notes: The City's official page confirms the museum and its role; visitor hours and location can change and are not asserted here.

communityTools.title: Online Business Permit and Licensing System
communityTools.description: City portal for new and renewal business permits, online payment options, application tracking, and approved permit issuance. Follow the portal's current instructions.
communityTools.notes: Portal and workflow details can change. Requisito does not submit applications or payments.

communityTools.title: Online Building Permit System
communityTools.description: City portal for building, occupancy, and related permit applications and application-status tracking.
communityTools.notes: The City identifies this as its online building-permit system. Confirm current application requirements on the portal.

communityTools.title: Online Cedula Application
communityTools.description: City portal for individuals applying for a Community Tax Certificate, with an online payment option described by the City.
communityTools.notes: Confirm eligibility, fees, payment, and current availability on the official portal.

communityTools.title: Online Professional Tax Receipt System
communityTools.description: City-listed portal for professionals to register, pay, and request professional tax receipts.
communityTools.notes: Confirm current eligibility, fees, and portal availability before applying.

communityTools.title: Davao City Online Payment
communityTools.description: City-listed online payment page for city taxes through authorized government depository banks.
communityTools.notes: Check the payment page and your assessment before paying; Requisito does not process payments.

communityTools.title: Davao City Reports App
communityTools.description: The City lists this portal for reporting local concerns and tracking updates from City departments. The external app's notice says registration may request contact details and location information; review its privacy notice before submitting.
communityTools.notes: The external portal is operated separately from Requisito. Requisito does not receive or forward reports.
